svg.text: Kit tag positions on the HIVE frame (calibration state: both audience CELLs up). Inches, field frame: origin field center on the tiles, Z up, +Y toward the audience.
SIDE VIEW (looking along +X; the audience, +Y, is on the LEFT)
tags 100 + 101: flat on the logo panel (edge-on here)
top edge flush with the panel top (y 1.67, z 40.02)
Frame: foot bar (gray) y -19.47..+19.47, 2.15 in high; legs to the 24 in crossbar (z 41.45); the logo panel
leans 24 deg (blue line). Red and blue HIVEs overlap in this view.
FRONT VIEW (from the audience, looking along -Y; +X, red, is on the LEFT)
tags 100 / 101: 6 in squares on the panel
outer edge 0.22 in inside the panel corner
foam wedge behind the card, inboard: x 18.73..22.75
foam wedge behind the card, inboard: x -18.73..-22.75
Both audience CELLs are up (calibration state): tip BOTH HIVEs by hand before calibrating. Black squares are the kit tags (to scale); dashed outlines are the CELLs that point away.
black square top edge: y 18.03, z 6.11
foam wedge 4 wide x 2 deep x 5.5 tall
Card = 6.00 in black square + 0.5 in white border (cut on the dashed line).
Card bottom edge on the tile at y = 19.47 + 2.15 tan 20 deg = 20.25
(0.78 in beyond the foot bar end); the card rests on the foot bar end's top edge.
Black-square bottom edge height = 0.5 x cos 20 deg = 0.47 in; top edge z 6.11.
Black square outer edge flush with the foot bar's outer face (x = +-24.73).
Wedge position along the card: INBOARD, x 18.73..22.75 (|x|), on the tile beside the foot bar (the bar is only
x 22.75..24.73), so it clears the bar; the card's outer 2 in rests on the bar end. Only the card position counts.
